name: move-coach
description: Camera pane with pose landmarks, spoken coaching and optional Muse EEG for the Built to Move mobility tests (macOS)

elevenlabs_api_key.title: ElevenLabs API key (optional)
elevenlabs_api_key.description: Leave blank to use the built-in macOS voice. With a key, coaching cues use ElevenLabs.

elevenlabs_voice_id.title: ElevenLabs voice ID (optional)
elevenlabs_voice_id.description: Blank uses the default voice (Sarah). Only used with an API key.
